attributes.title: WVC Vegas 2027
attributes.summary:
WVC Vegas 2027 runs Sunday to Wednesday, February 28 to March 3, 2027, at the Mandalay Bay Convention Center in Las Vegas. The organizer describes hundreds of hours of RACE-approved continuing education for veterinarians, veterinary technicians, practice managers and students.

Beyond lectures, the program mixes hands-on labs, workshops, education symposia, industry seminars and learning tracks; some of these formats cost extra. CE is also offered inside the exhibit hall. Discounted room rates are available at Mandalay Bay and nearby hotels through the official housing page. Registration is open: veterinarians currently pay $549 and veterinary technicians, practice managers and other discounted types $349, after earlier lower-priced tiers sold out; students and active military register free.
